name: web-ai-showcase runtime pin inventory & allowlist
description: Authorized runtime versions and intentional escape hatches (web-ai-showcase-bm6, web-ai-showcase-xkt, web-ai-showcase-djr). Shared transformers.js pin is 3.7.5; upgrade to 4.3.0 is a staged rollout per reports/transformers-version-policy.md. Raw-ORT pins: 1.21.0 is the consolidated target for the literal-pinned bulk; 1.20.1 is a deliberate, evidence-backed hold (see its reason); migrations are tracked under web-ai-showcase-62m with the full inventory in reports/raw-ort-pins-62m.md. Any new or unlisted pin fails the currency gate.

allowedLocalOverrides.reason: Documented escape hatch for architectures unsupported in 3.7.5 (Sam2Model, Qwen2.5-VL, FastVLM/Docling, LFM2, Ernie, Gemma-3-270m, Apertus)
allowedLocalOverrides.evidence: AGENTS.md version-pin escape hatch; verified in respective worker.js and index.html files

allowedLocalOverrides.reason: Phase 1 staged rollout of 4.3.0 for representative feature-extraction route with verified browser acceptance

embedding_gemma2 requires Transformers.js >= 4.3.1: the EmbeddingGemma2Model class, the EmbeddingGemma2(PreTrained)Model + EmbeddingGemma2Processor/VideoProcessor exports and the embedding_gemma2 model-type registration are all absent from 4.3.0 and from the shared 3.7.5 pin (verified by dynamic import of each CDN build in headless Chrome). Scoped to THIS worker only.
allowedLocalOverrides.evidence: models/embeddinggemma-2/worker.js pins the CDN URL; in-browser probe of 3.7.5/4.3.0/4.3.1 shows EmbeddingGemma2Model exported only by 4.3.1; scripts/validate-embeddinggemma-2.mjs drives the family on 4.3.1.

allowedVersions.reason: Deliberate hold, 10 routes, do NOT migrate in a version sweep. The 8 VoxPopuli ASR workers (croatian/czech/dutch/german/hungarian/romanian/slovak/slovenian) record real headless-Chrome verification on ORT Web 1.20.1 / WASM EP (real log-probs, coherent transcript), and upstream onnxruntime #23183 documents 1.21.x breaking Segment-Anything-class models on WebGPU. pitch-detection and silero-vad were also built against 1.20.1 and have no measured 1.21.0 run; migrating either needs its own real-inference acceptance run (model2vec-static-embeddings left this hold in web-ai-showcase-62m.4). See reports/raw-ort-pins-62m.md.
allowedVersions.evidence: reports/raw-ort-pins-62m.md; worker headers of the 8 VoxPopuli routes; upstream onnxruntime issue #23183; node scripts/raw-ort-inventory.mjs

allowedVersions.reason: Default stable raw-ORT version across majority of raw ONNX routes

derivedInventory.reason: These three files together are a GENERATED integrity inventory, not route-level version decisions. The service worker can only verify a runtime's bytes if it holds that exact URL's hash, so the manifest must contain the literal versioned URL of every runtime the built routes fetch, INCLUDING transitive ones the routes never name themselves (spelled out below). The exemption is version-scoped: a version may appear in these files ONLY if it is in measuredVersions, which was derived from runtime-integrity.json. Any OTHER version in these files still fails this gate.
measuredLineage: transformers 3.1.2 - bundled inside outetts 0.2.0, which the outetts route loads
transformers 3.7.5 - the shared pin, loaded by the bulk of routes
transformers 4.2.0 - documented override routes (apertus-1-5b, ernie-4-5-0-3b, gemma-3-270m, lfm2, qwen2.5-vl, sam2-segmentation, smoldocling-document)

onnxruntime-web 1.24.0-dev.20251116-b39e144322 and onnxruntime-web 1.26.0-dev.20260416-b7804b056c - BOTH dev literals carried by the transformers 4.2.0 bundle; which one is selected is internal to it, so both are pinned
onnxruntime-web 1.31.0-dev.20260914-8d85527a0 - selected internally by the transformers 4.3.0 bundle

onnxruntime-web 1.20.1 - deliberate hold (10 routes, see allowedVersions); onnxruntime-web 1.21.0 - consolidated target; onnxruntime-web 1.22.0 - appears only in this generated inventory (its runtime-integrity entry), never as a route pin

measuredVersions records FULL version tokens (dev suffixes included). The gate compares the whole token, so a base-version normalisation like reading 3.7.5-evil.1 as the allowed 3.7.5 can no longer pass.
gatedBy: STATED ACCURATELY: the coverage audit (scripts/verify-runtime-integrity-coverage.mjs) is NOT part of `deno task gate` and is NOT run by CI. It is a manually-run, browser-driven check over 6 representative routes, not 327. It tests for MISSING manifest entries (under-coverage) and does NOT itself validate that manifest versions are authorised - that is what this currency gate does, which is why the exemption is version-scoped here rather than trusted to that script.

test/service-worker-runtime-integrity.test.mjs (14 tests): validates manifest schema and fails on drift between the block embedded in sw.js and runtime-integrity.json. It does NOT validate runtime versions against the allowlist.
scripts/runtime-integrity.mjs is a maintenance generator needing network access. It is not a gate.
